text:
incident-bot: Pager: oncall-liam — High error rate (502/503) in ap-southeast-2 affecting Redwood hosted API. Please respond. Priority: P1 :rotating_light:

liam: ACK — jumping in. seeing spike in ALB 5xx for /v1/generate from ap-southeast-2b. metrics: 5xx rate ~18% for last 2m.

ana: I'm on mobile, but getting user reports too. Some customers in APAC showing timeouts ~8-12s then 502.

liam: quick diagnostic: curl to internal health on a few targets shows IO errors. sample:

```
curl -s -D - http://10.12.4.21:8080/health
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: text/plain

EBS IO error: i/o timeout attaching volume vol-0abc1234 to i-0f123456
```

kevin: ELB reports target registration/failing checks, connection resets. ALB logs show: "HTTP/1.1 \"POST /v1/generate\" 502 - \"-\" 0 0 0 0 \"-\" \"-\" \"target:pool\" 502"

liam: Route53 alarms also firing: health-check ap-southeast-2 endpoint flapping. Weighted routing policy in place to send 20% to eu-west-1 as backup. Looks like DNS health-checks have started failing, triggering weight shift to other region which is now observing increased latency and saturation.

maria: AWS console shows a surge of EBS Attach/Detach errors in ap-southeast-2b. EBS API has "Request throttled" and "attach timed out" events. Could be regional control plane degradation.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-493210 — ap-southeast-2 EBS attach/control-plane anomalies causing ALB 5xx and Route53 failover.

liam: Mitigation plan (short):
1) Pause Route53 health-check-driven weight failovers to avoid oscillation. set health-check override to keep traffic pinned to primary while we stabilize.
2) Scale up us-west-2 and eu-west-1 ingress to absorb shifted traffic (short-term autoscale + add Dedicated capacity routes).
3) Enable ALB header-based routing to send new sessions to unaffected AZs/instance pools in the region (if healthy).
4) Engage AWS Support with control-plane logs & EBS error traces.

ana: I'm taking handoff in 10m, liam — can you drop your current notes and runbook snippets?

liam: copying runbook excerpt below and my AWS CLI snippets. please confirm before applying.

--- runbook snippet ---
# Route53: suspend health-check failover (temporary)
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZXXXXXXXXXXXX --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"apse2-primary","Weight":80,"Region":"ap-southeast-2","HealthCheckId":"abcd1234","TTL":60}}]}'

# Alternatively, explicitly set weights to pin 100 -> primary to avoid auto failover
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZXXXXXXXXXXXX --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"apse2-primary","Weight":100,"TTL":60}},{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"eu-backup","Weight":0,"TTL":60}}]}'

# ALB: check target health and set deregistration delay low for draining
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:ap-southeast-2:123:targetgroup/tg-abc/def --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=30

--- end runbook ---

kevin: thumbs up for pinning weights to avoid feedback loop. I'll prepare the Route53 change and hold until ana confirms.

maria: AWS Support case opened, case# 1234567890. They confirm "partial EBS control plane degradation in ap-southeast-2b" and are looking into attach/volume state transitions. They've asked for the list of affected volumes + instance ids. Logged into SRE logs and exporting:
- vol-0abc1234 attached to i-0f123456 (error attach timeout)
- vol-01bcd2345 detach loop seen on i-0d234567

kevin: Applying Route53 weight pin now (I'll switch weights to 100/0). Applying in 10s.

liam: WAIT — do not apply until we confirm forwarding capacity. If we pin 100% to ap-southeast-2 and it's still unhealthy, customers will stay impacted. Better: pin 80/20 while we warm extra capacity in eu and us. We should avoid flip-flopping.

kevin: rolling back — setting 80/20 then. change submitted. Route53 change ID: /change/C0ABCDEFG

incident-bot: Route53 change /change/C0ABCDEFG propagated: pending -> INSYNC (approx 27s).

sre-jordan: Monitoring data: after weight change, eu-west CPU for inference pools increased 4x and latency rose. We're seeing some tail latency but within ~200ms. Request queueing on Dedicated is kicking in. Will ramp capacity.

ana: handoff: I'm now primary oncall. liam handing to ana. Notes: AWS case open, Request IDs and logs attached in INC-2026-493210 doc. Route53 pinned 80/20. ALB deregistration delay set to 30s. Scaling eu/us pools in progress.

ana: immediate tasks for me:
- coordinate with AWS Support for ETA on control plane recovery
- watch Route53 health-check status and avoid further automated weight flips
- ensure customers on-hosted tier have mitigation (priority queue to Dedicated where possible)
- notify Customer Success on impacted customers and provide status update

maria: CS update drafted: "We are investigating an infrastructure-related issue in ap-southeast-2 causing intermittent 5xx errors for some API traffic. Traffic is being routed to backup regions to reduce impact. We will share updates every 30m and notify once AWS confirms control-plane stabilization." LMK to send.

aws-support: AWS Support: we've elevated to Engineering. We're seeing EBS attach throttles in ap-southeast-2b tied to control-plane S3-backed state store delays. Our engineers are performing deeper traces. No ETA yet, will provide updates within 30 minutes.

liam: gathering additional logs for AWS: kernel logs, dmesg, attach API traces, instance metadata service logs. dropping into the incident doc.

kevin: we've also enabled an emergency routing policy on the Redwood runtime to prefer Dedicated capacity endpoints for new sessions from APAC while failing over older sessions gracefully. Patch deployed.

incident-bot: Reminder: next incident status update window in 30m.

ana: thanks team. continuing monitoring. I'll escalate if metrics don't improve in 15m. ana -> oncall handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

maria: CS message sent to impacted accounts. internal tracking: TICKET-8892 linked to INC-2026-493210.

sre-jordan: current numbers (T+20m): ap-southeast-2 5xx down from 18% -> 9%, overall request volume ~stable, EU and US regions handling increased load. Will continue to watch for Route53 oscillation.

liam: good progress — keeping incident open until AWS confirms EBS control plane recovered. If attach errors stop and ALB target health normalizes for 3 consecutive 5-minute windows, we can begin demobilize steps.

ana: acknowledged. updating incident channel every 15m or on any critical change.

kevin: FYI added an action item to postmortem: consider adding cross-region EBS replication for critical volumes and refine Route53 weighted cool-down to avoid rapid flapping.

maria: +1 for postmortem. Also capture customer-facing SLA impact and list of affected tenants.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-493210 status: monitoring — P1 — ap-southeast-2 partial EBS/control-plane degradation.
